audit.whatIsWrong: The chart disagreed with its own prose at four stages. Level 1 was scored Cassiopeia while whys[0], spikes[0] and early all say Gnar wins that trade; levels 3 and 4-5 were scored Gnar while whys[2] and whys[3] say she owns them; first item was scored Gnar while whys[5] calls it 'genuinely even'. The Cassiopeia-side mirror spotted the level-1 conflict but left it, believing the length band would reject a chart cell.
audit.why: The band does not apply: win[N], phases[N].side and phases[N].rating are enum fields and are exempt (apply-proposals.js ENUM_FIELD), so the cell can be flipped. Mechanically the prose is right — Miasma (24/22/20/18/16s) is not up at 1, and from 3 it grounds Hop while ramped Twin Fang (0.75s) shreds Mini.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Gnar, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Skill, Gnar — identical to the packet chart and to every existing why.

audit.why: Cassiopeia spikes at 3 (Miasma), 6 (Petrifying Gaze, 120/100/80s) and 2+ items with Rylai's/Liandry's; Gnar's window is levels 1-2 and any loaded Rage bar. spikes[].when already labels these correctly.
audit.corrected: No structural change; the first-item stage is now scored even, matching whys[5].

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already stated on both layers and stated correctly: Miasma grounds, so Hop (22s at rank 1) cannot disengage and Mega Crunch is disabled inside the cloud, and Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her. What was missing was the cooldown number that makes the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Miasma's 24s rank-1 cooldown written into the cooldown block, the do's and the don'ts so the grounding window has a length.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions Grievous Wounds, though Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt and is her main damage button.
audit.why: Twin Fang carries the heal flag and is spammable at 0.75s, so in any extended trade her sustain outpaces Gnar's chip unless anti-heal is bought.
audit.corrected: Executioner's added to the itemization line.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames are false positives: 'Twin Fangs' is the correct ability pluralised in prose, and 'Petrifying Gaze' matches the kit exactly.

notes: This resolves the chart conflict the Cassiopeia-side mirror escalated to the user. Its stated reason for not fixing it — that rewriting a chart cell is a 60% length change the band rejects — is not correct: win[N], phases[N].side and phases[N].rating are enum fields and exempt, so the flips are proposed here as one atomic group across both layers.
